title: Equality of right fractions is detected by a common refinement
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category, $S$ a class of its arrows with a right calculus of fractions [lem-pc-quasi-isomorphisms-multiplicative-system], and $Q:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ a localization at $S$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $s_i:P_i\to M$ belong to $S$ and $f_i:P_i\to N$ for $i=1,2$. Then $Q(f_1)\circ Q(s_1)^{-1}=Q(f_2)\circ Q(s_2)^{-1}$ if and only if there are an object $R$ and arrows $a_i:R\to P_i$ with $s_1\circ a_1=s_2\circ a_2\in S$ and $f_1\circ a_1=f_2\circ a_2$.
